strips.title: A day with the Bedsure heated throw — in real life

panels.head: 6 p.m. — first cold snap
panels.text: The thermostat stays put. Vera drapes the throw over her knees on the sofa and presses Preheat.

panels.head: About 30 minutes later
panels.text: One reviewer reports full warmth in about half an hour on preheat. Level 3 or 4 is plenty for a sofa.

panels.head: The label check
panels.text: Before first use: find the model number on the back label or the controller and compare it with the 2023 recall list.

panels.head: 10 p.m. — unplugged
panels.text: Switched off and unplugged before bed. ESFI advises against leaving a heated blanket on unattended.
